name: zenbrain
description: Memory for Claude Code that lasts across sessions: the ZenBrain MCP server with five tools (store, recall, forget, consolidate, health) over one local SQLite file. No account, no network call of its own.

db_path.title: Memory file
db_path.description: SQLite file that holds the memory. A leading ~/ means your home directory. The default is the file the claude mcp add line in the ZenBrain README uses, so both setups share one memory.
